headline: Subway Surfers: first to 1 billion
title: Subway Surfers Was the First Game With 1 Billion Google Play Downloads | Classic Games
video_script: Subway Surfers launched on May twenty fourth, twenty twelve, built by Danish studios Kiloo and SYBO Games. You play Jake, a graffiti kid running from the Inspector and his dog. In March twenty eighteen it became the first game ever to pass one billion downloads on Google Play, and it hit two billion two months later. Which character did you pick? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Escape the Inspector and his dog
First game on Google Play, March 2018

description: Subway Surfers (Kiloo and SYBO Games, released May 24, 2012) became the first game on Google Play to pass one billion downloads in March 2018 and reached two billion in May 2018.
